tip.subscriptionAdd:
Import profiles from a subscription URL.

Accepted subscriptions for:
• Happ, Incy — incl. Xray JSON, title, traffic, expiry, auto-update
• v2rayN / v2rayNG, Hiddify, Streisand, v2RayTun, Throne (Nekoray) — base64 or plain list of links

Links: https://…, happ://add/…, throne://subscribe?url=…, sing-box://import-remote-profile?url=…, clash://install-config?url=…, hiddify://import/…
Protocols: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, SOCKS

Not supported: happ://crypt… (encrypted), Clash YAML and sing-box JSON configs, TUIC / AmneziaWG servers.
If the list shows an "App not supported" stub, the provider serves only its own app — select the subscription in the panel and press “Rename” to set that app's User-Agent.

routing.title: Routing
tip.directDomains: Domains routed directly (bypassing the VPN), overriding geo rules — e.g. yandex.ru
domains.title: Direct domains
domains.hint: Type a domain and press comma or Enter to add it as a tag. Traffic to these domains (and their subdomains) bypasses the VPN. Example: yandex.ru covers mail.yandex.ru, disk.yandex.ru.
tip.proxyDomains: Domains forced through the VPN, overriding the direct/geo rules — e.g. a foreign site wrongly treated as Russian.
proxyDomains.title: Via-VPN domains
proxyDomains.hint: Type a domain and press comma or Enter to add it as a tag. Traffic to these domains (and their subdomains) goes through the VPN, overriding the direct / Russian-site rules.
dns.title: DNS resolver
dns.hint: Used for traffic that bypasses the VPN. Which one is fastest depends on where you are — check and pick.
dns.noneReachable: No DNS resolver responded — check your connection
tip.dnsCheck: Measure every resolver from this computer
